description: Source code for managing thermostat schedules, including parsing XML nodes, comparing schedules, and memory management functions.

methods.name: contians_schedule
methods.description: Checks if a given schedule exists in a list of schedules, considering mode, temperature, time, and IDs.

methods.name: icrule_free_schedule
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a schedule, including its ID list.

methods.name: icrule_parse_schedule
methods.description: Parses an XML node to create and add a thermostat schedule to a list, merging with existing schedules if similar.
